hushstep.name: Hushstep
hushstep.description: A quick step that leaves a fading tone where you stood. Brief invulnerability.

toll.name: Toll
toll.description: A cone of low sound that staggers enemies and breaks guards.

lantern_song.name: Lantern Song
lantern_song.description: A held note that heals you and nearby allies and pushes back the Hush.

echo_mark.name: Echo Mark
echo_mark.description: Marks a target's weak point and raises your pitch match against it.

reed_bind.name: Reed Bind
reed_bind.description: Reeds rise and hold a target in place for three seconds.

counterpoint.name: Counterpoint
counterpoint.description: A parry that answers with a free heavy strike. Wider window than a normal parry.

second_verse.name: Second Verse
second_verse.description: Revive a downed companion with a returning note.

quiet_passage.name: Quiet Passage
quiet_passage.description: For a few seconds, enemies lose track of you and the Hush cannot find your name.
